contexts.text: The fir, pitch pine, and box = celestial natural things; thus the things which are externals of worship. ( = natural goods and truths which correspond. AC 9406:2.) AE 375:33.
The torch of the love of the sex...
To set in the solitude the fir, pitch pine, and box () = natural truths, which are scientifics and Knowledges, with their understanding... The pitch pine = lower natural truth.
